svg.title: Hux V1-PROOF Both wheel motors — every wire
svg.desc: Two complete channels through the leg junction board. Rails and nSLEEP come from EL-01. Use terminal names here. EL-01 has the conductor register IDs. Source-checked planning drawing; proposed harnesses and unresolved interfaces require physical verification.

17 x 11 in / landscape / 0.5 in margins / print at 100%. Sources and open checks: docs/wiring-atlas.md.

g.text: GPIO terminals on PH-A, PH-B, PH-D, PH-E
Pololu 4035 carrier on the driver board
1x6 0.1 in header for the pigtail · dividers 2.2 kΩ / 3.3 kΩ
OUT1 → RED, OUT2 → BLACK pass through on the board.
A, B: 2.2 kΩ series, 3.3 kΩ to GND → 3.0 V high level.
GREEN → GND, BLUE → 5 V on the board rails.
BLACK is a switched motor lead.
